title: Huzoor Palace Porbandar - Royal Heritage & Seaside Landmark in Gujarat
content:
Huzoor Palace, Porbandar

The Huzoor Palace in Porbandar is one of Gujarat’s most elegant and historically significant landmarks. Built during the early 20th century by Maharaja Natwarsinhji, the last ruler of the Porbandar princely state, this magnificent palace stands as a symbol of royal heritage and architectural grandeur. Overlooking the Arabian Sea, the palace beautifully blends European and Indian architectural styles, making it a must-visit for history lovers and architecture enthusiasts.

History and Architecture:

The Huzoor Palace was constructed in the early 1900s during the reign of Maharaja Natwarsinhji, who later became famous as the first captain of the Indian cricket team in 1932. The palace served as the royal residence and still exudes an aura of regal sophistication.

The architecture reflects European influences with spacious verandas, sloping roofs, and decorative columns. Surrounded by lush gardens and open courtyards, the palace’s design showcases the opulent lifestyle of Porbandar’s royal family. Though entry inside the palace is restricted since it is still a private residence of the royal descendants, visitors can admire its beauty from the outside and capture stunning photographs, especially during sunset.

Attractions Around Huzoor Palace:

  • Chowpatty Beach: Located nearby, ideal for relaxing and enjoying coastal views.
  • Kirti Mandir: A memorial dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi, Porbandar’s most famous son.
  • Sudama Mandir: A temple dedicated to Lord Krishna’s friend, Sudama.
  • Porbandar Bird Sanctuary: Perfect for bird watchers and nature lovers.

Best Time to Visit:

The best time to visit Huzoor Palace is between October and February, when the weather is pleasant for exploring Porbandar’s coastal beauty.

Tips for Visitors:

  • Entry inside the palace is not permitted, but it’s worth viewing from the outside.
  • Visit in the evening to capture beautiful sunset photographs.
  • Combine your visit with a trip to Chowpatty Beach and nearby attractions.
